rationale: finetuning.uk's playground page describes a chat with a fine-tuned model but has no chat (owner, 2026-09-03: 'the playground has no playground'; 'please sort out the tool'; decision the same day: BOTH a public demo and booked GPU hours). This is the public door for it: a third route group in tools-api, /api/v1/tools/playground/chat, that streams one reply from a self-hosted Ollama model as server-sent events. It copies the gripper's security shape exactly (CORS by deployed-site Origin, then the group's own body cap, then a per-IP httpguard band) and is opt-in like the gripper (mounted only when PLAYGROUND_OLLAMA_URL is set AND main passes the deps; a deployment not told about it serves exactly the routes it served before). It is stateless on purpose: the browser holds the transcript and sends it back, capped at 12 messages of 1000 runes. The model server is reached only from the island by URL; where that server lives (a small CPU VM; the in-cluster Ollama is NOT reachable from the island by design) is a deployment decision outside this change. No paid LLM API is in the path. Measured basis for the caps: the demo model on CPU does ~14 tok/s (2026-09-03), so num_predict defaults to 150 and the per-request timeout is 90 s; streaming exists because 150 tokens is ~11 s and a single JSON body would read as a stall.

plan.summary: finetuning.uk's playground page has no playground: the owner decided (2026-09-03) on a public demo chat against a self-hosted open-weight model plus booked GPU hours. This change adds the public door only: a third, opt-in route group in tools-api, POST /api/v1/tools/playground/chat, mounted only when PLAYGROUND_OLLAMA_URL is set and main wires the deps, copying the gripper's security shape (CORS by deployed-site Origin -> the group's own body cap -> per-IP httpguard band). It validates a browser-held transcript (<=12 messages, <=1000 runes each, roles user/assistant, last from the user), calls Ollama /api/chat streaming with num_predict/num_ctx caps and a fixed system prompt, and relays tokens as server-sent events (token/done/error). Errors before the first token are JSON 400/503; after it, in-band. No paid LLM API is in the path; where the model server runs is a deployment decision outside this change (the island cannot reach the in-cluster Ollama by design).
plan.risks: (1) CORS depends on the ISLAND's own sites table having finetuning.uk at status='deployed' (today it holds robot-hands.com and vonc.com only); without that row every browser call 403s — a deployment prerequisite, not a code path. (2) The model server URL is trusted config: a wrong URL yields 503s, never a leak, because nothing from the visitor reaches any other host. (3) Streaming commits status 200 before the reply is known; a mid-stream failure is reported as event: error, and the tests pin that. (4) The per-IP band (60/h, 300/d) is per-pod in-memory like the gripper's; the island runs one pod. (5) The system prompt is fixed English text in code; changing the demo's voice is a code change, which is deliberate (the demo is not LLM-voiced). Reviewer should check: the mount order matches mountGripper; no route is registered when either config or deps is absent; the body cap runs before any model call; num_predict is forwarded.
